faces.license: Font Awesome 3 (SIL OFL 1.1), Liferay alloy build

fonts.note: faces declared font-weight: normal like the source; weight 700 on latoregular synthesises bold as live does. Use var(--ce-font) / var(--ce-font-bold) / var(--ce-font-light) / var(--ce-font-icon).

container.rule: main > .section > div { max-width: var(--max-width); margin: 0 auto }
container.fullBleedEscape: section style full-bleed -> main > .section.full-bleed > div { max-width: none }; blocks may also escape at their own wrapper

header.doc: /nav (content/nav.html), overridable per page via metadata nav
sections: actions ul (Accés -> login modal, Dona't d'alta)
login modal (h2, accessible link, banca-online iframe link, ul, texts, strong CTA)
languages ul (es -> source /es/<path>, ca -> current path)
main nav nested ul (3 levels; 2nd-level item with a nested ul = mega panel toggle)
search p link (results page base; submits to <base>search/<q>?)

hooks.body.home or path '/' or metadata header: shows the Fundació button (hidden on every other page, as live)
hooks.metadata nav-selected=<top label>: selects that top-level nav item (default: first, Particulars)

footer.doc: /footer (content/footer.html), overridable per page via metadata footer
sections: contact (title p, ul, strong tel CTA)

hooks.--footer-gap: footer top margin; 40px default, 30px on body.accidentes / body.program (product templates); a template sets it on body
